copy.summary: Two I2S amps, one per channel
copy.wiringNote: Both boards share BCLK, LRC and DIN. Each plays the channel its SD pin selects (see the SD_MODE table in the MAX98357A datasheet); an unmodified breakout plays the left-plus-right mix, so set one board to left and the other to right.
